turns.prompt_text: where is a good place to study in Ankeny
turns.response_html: Ankeny offers several excellent study spots, including the Ankeny Kirkendall Public Library, which has study rooms and conference spaces, and various coffee shops like Cafe Diem, which provides a comfortable atmosphere with outlets and free WiFi. The Des Moines Area Community College (DMACC) Ankeny campus also provides a great academic environment for students.
